governing_identity_chain.CANDIDATE_COMPONENT: sorted member subject IDs + sorted pair projection IDs + build rule version
governing_identity_chain.CANDIDATE_FAMILY: immutable candidate origin key derived from exact components, attachment projections, diagnostic lane, and subject set

logical_consequence: CANDIDATE_COMPONENT identity includes pair projection IDs.
CANDIDATE_FAMILY origin includes exact component and attachment-projection identities.
Therefore a release-only change changes projections, components, and every family origin even when members, pair facts, endpoints, topology, and origin lane are unchanged.

required_contract_split.release_scoped_revision_evidence: May retain concrete projection/component IDs and release-specific authority.
required_contract_split.release_neutral_family_semantic_origin: Must be derived from origin lane, exact subject set, release-neutral component semantic fingerprints, and release-neutral attachment projection semantic fingerprints.
